analysis:
The PR renames the autopilot admission predicate from autopilotAllowsModel to autopilotServesModel at two sites in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift. The first is the local-work gate throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork (head line 135). The second is the authoritative coordinator admission check before inference_accepted and requestToModel registration (head line 513). The range map is complete, and these are the only changes.

The surrounding flow is unchanged:
- Decryption still happens before admission.
- Drain, MTP and deadline re-checks are still made.
- The lookup receipt finalizer settles once.
- The streaming and billing tail (base lines 1144-1569) is unchanged.

Security relevance is limited to availability and model-placement policy (provider capacity). The change does not touch encryption (A-001/A-003), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), cache scope (T-041) or billing.

The definition of autopilotServesModel is not in the supplied evidence. I cannot confirm whether it is stricter or looser than autopilotAllowsModel. Either way, a mismatch would only admit or reject requests for local models. The autopilotManagesResidency warm-only check and ensureModelLoaded still remain. Even a looser predicate does not bypass the coordinator's routing or authorization; that stays platform-owned.

Open question for integration: verify the autopilotServesModel semantics. In particular, check that it does not admit models the operator deselected, which would matter for owner-local work at line 135. No security regression was identified.
